sammendrag: This chapter discusses the main barriers to participation in and provision of adult learning reported by individuals and firms in Australia. If well-designed, financial incentives can help individuals and firms to overcome barriers related to cost and time, thus promoting greater engagement in adult learning. Six types of financial incentives are presented – individual learning accounts, training leave, training vouchers, subsidised training programmes, training levies, and tax incentives – along with examples of how they have been implemented in Australia and in other countries.
tittel: Financial incentives to address barriers to adult learning
